title: JANUS POSS-I Nuclear Calendar — 124/125/126 Row-Definition Discrepancy Audit
purpose: Prevent post-hoc choice of nuclear-test dates in the POSS-I transient analysis by explicitly freezing the presently documented 124, 125 and 126 calendar-count variants as different source/parsing definitions requiring side-by-side reproduction.

variants.source: Watters et al., Critical Evaluation of Studies Alleging Evidence for Technosignatures in the POSS1-E Photographic Plates (2026)
variants.source_family: authors report attempting to use the same three nuclear-date sources cited by Bruehl & Villarroel
variants.reported_explanation: The one-date difference from 124 is likely due to differences in parsing the three cited sources.

variants.source: independent full-footprint POSS-I reanalysis described in the JANUS Phase-0 gate

US.title: United States Nuclear Tests: July 1945 through September 1992
US.publisher: U.S. Department of Energy / NNSA Nevada Field Office

UK.title: United Kingdom overseas atmospheric nuclear weapons tests 1952-58

USSR.rule: Do not fill Soviet rows from memory. Literal reproduction must first preserve the exact source cited by the 2025 study; an authoritative-source sensitivity calendar may then be built separately.

required_reconciliation.filter_definition: above-ground nuclear tests only, with every inclusion/exclusion explicitly typed
comparison_outputs: Palomar observing plate-days whose +/-1-day membership changes under each variant
beta_nuclear and IRR under each frozen variant

anti_p_hacking_rule: All calendar variants and inclusion rules must be frozen before target beta_nuclear is inspected. The variant yielding the most significant coefficient may not be promoted to primary after the fact.
primary_rule: CAL_ORIGINAL_2025_124 remains the literal-reproduction primary if its exact row set can be recovered. CAL_WATTERS_2026_125 and CAL_HAYES_2026_126 are preregistered sensitivity/control calendars.
failure_rule: If the exact 124-row membership cannot be reconstructed, the original-calendar reproduction is INCOMPLETE; do not silently choose a 125/126 reconstruction and call it exact replication.
